services: AC and heating repair — no cooling, no heat, weak airflow, strange noises, leaks
System replacement and new installs (free in-home estimate)
Thermostats, ductwork, and indoor air quality
emergency_triggers: No AC when it's very hot outside (roughly 100°F+), especially with elderly people, infants, someone sick or pregnant, or pets at home
Gas smell, a carbon monoxide alarm going off, or burning/electrical smell from the unit
Water leaking from the system into the house
safety_line: - If they smell gas or a carbon monoxide alarm is going off: tell them to get everyone out of the house and call 911 or the gas company from outside first. Then continue.
triage_questions: - What's going on — not cooling, not heating, not turning on, noise, leak?
- Is it a central system, heat pump, or something else? Roughly how old is it, if they know?
- Is anyone at home elderly, very young, or unwell? (This decides urgency in the heat.)
- Repair, or are they looking at replacing the system? Replacements get a free estimate visit.
faq: - Do you service my brand? Most major brands — {{owner_name}} will confirm on the callback.
- Financing on new systems: say {{owner_name}} can go over options at the estimate.
callback_promise: today if it's during business hours, or first thing tomorrow
